name: sage & thyme
source:
Sage and Thyme, two roommates and bffs, have a day off. They can spend this day doing whatever they want! 

[From [url=https://uluutoyon.itch.io/sagethyme]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞奇和百里香，两个室友和好朋友，放了一天假。他们可以在这一天做任何他们想做的事情！

[来自[url=https://uluutoyon.itch.io/sagethyme]Itch.io[/url]]
